services:
  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml:ro
      - promdata:/prometheus
    ports: ["9090:9090"]

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: {{grafana_password}}
    ports: ["3000:3000"]
    volumes: ["grafanadata:/var/lib/grafana"]
    depends_on: [prometheus]

volumes:
  promdata:
  grafanadata:
